description:
JOIN CONTORO ROBOTICS – REVOLUTIONIZING WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION WITH CUTTING-EDGE ROBOTICS

At Contoro Robotics, we're on a mission to solve labor challenges through advanced robotic solutions. Headquartered in Austin, TX, our fast-growing startup is transforming the supply chain industry with our flagship warehouse automation technology. Our team is made up of top-tier experts in robotics, AI, and logistics, working together to push the boundaries of automation.

We’re looking for talented and ambitious individuals to join us on this journey—helping shape the future of robotics while growing alongside a world-class team. If you're passionate about innovation, problem-solving, and making a real-world impact, we want to hear from you!


ROLE AT GLANCE

The Test & Validation team verifies and validates Contoro's robotic systems before they reach customer sites, ensuring every robot performs reliably in demanding environments. We're looking for a Test & Validation Engineer to own how our robot's software is tested and released, produce results the team can trust, and grow into owning our release process across the fleet.

The immediate focus will be hands-on: building regression tests, running structured tests on physical robots in our test trailers, and leading root cause analysis alongside our autonomy, perception, cloud and controls engineers. As you learn the system, scope will expand to defining test strategy, coordinating release schedules, and serving as the central point of accountability for release decisions.

We are looking for someone committed to understanding the problem in depth. You will build a thorough understanding of each customer’s operating constraints, including trailer types, product mix, throughput requirements and site conditions, as well as how and why the robot fails in the field. You will then use that understanding to design tests that find issues before they reach our customers.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Design test plans and test cases from requirements, customer configurations and known field failure modes, with clear objectives and pass/fail acceptance criteria

 - Execute recurring software release testing (regression, integration, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop) on release candidates before they ship to customer sites

 - Lead failure replication, exploratory and A/B testing of robot software versions, and turn the results into data-backed recommendations that shape what engineering builds next

 - Work side by side with autonomy, perception and controls engineers to track software failures from testing and the field to their source and confirm each fix holds

 - Partner with the deployment team to take every field issue from test, to fix, to verified release, and lead staged rollouts at customer sites

 - Deliver release summaries on test coverage, open issues and known risks, with a clear recommendation the team acts on

 - Track key performance metrics across releases to flag trends and regressions, and use statistical analysis to find what drives failures

 - Write clear, structured and traceable test reports for every release and test conducted, covering objectives, setup, software versions and results against acceptance criteria


ABOUT YOU

Required Skills

 - Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or 5+ years of experience in designing/testing hardware and software platforms

 - First-principles understanding of core robotics software components, such as computer vision, kinematics, motion planning, and controls

 - 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and executing test procedures for complex electro-mechanical systems in a lab or startup environment

 - Familiarity with core test methodologies: understanding of verification vs validation (V-model) and how to apply it in fast, iterative release cycles

 - Ability to analyze test and field data with statistical methods (hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample sizing, regression) and explain what the results show

 - Comfortable setting up physical devices under test and sensors: mounting, wiring, calibrating and configuring them, and verifying the setup before running tests

 - Ability to understand engineering drawings, software configurations, and test procedures, and resolve missing information with the appropriate responsible engineer

 - Comfortable with Linux, shell scripting, Git and containerized environments (Docker)

 - Excellent written and verbal communication

 - Willingness to travel to customer sites (up to 10%)

Preferred Skills

 - Familiarity with ROS / ROS 2

 - Strong Python, with experience building automated tests in CI/CD pipelines

 - Tracking work in Jira, Confluence or similar tools

 - Experience with industrial robot arms (KUKA) or warehouse automation

 - Building data pipelines and dashboards (SQL, Grafana or similar)

 - Robotics simulation (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo or similar)
